title: How Parking Sensors Work in 60 Seconds 🚗🔊 #shorts
description:
The small dots on a car bumper are ultrasonic sensors: each one is a speaker and a microphone in one. They send out sound too high for us to hear, time how long the echo takes to come back, and use the speed of sound to work out the distance, beeping faster as you get closer. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#parkingsensors #cars #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: Those little dots on a bumper are *speakers* and *microphones* in one.

steps.label: Ping
steps.text: Each sensor fires a short burst of *ultrasound*, far too high for us to hear.

steps.label: Echo
steps.text: The sound bounces off an obstacle, and the *same sensor* listens for the *echo*.

steps.label: Timing
steps.text: Sound travels about *343 meters per second*, so the echo's *time* gives the distance.

steps.label: Teamwork
steps.text: Several sensors work together, so the car can tell *where* the obstacle is, not just *how far*.

steps.label: Beeps
steps.text: The closer you get, the *faster* the beeps, until one *solid tone* says stop.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Ping, echo, *beep*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
